title: Store Settings
subtitle: Global configuration and management
desc: Manage core store configurations, payments, shipping, and advanced options.

general.title: Store Identity
general.desc: Update basic store information and branding.

seo.title: SEO Settings
seo.desc: Optimize your store visibility in search results.

social.title: Social Media
social.desc: Link your store to your social accounts.

contact.title: Contact Info
contact.businessAddressDesc: Company address details and registration info.

payments.title: Payment Gateways
payments.enableOnlineDesc: Allow users to pay online using the configured payment methods.

bankTransfer.title: Bank Transfer Details
bankTransfer.desc: Add your bank account details to be shown to customers when they choose to pay via bank transfer.

shipping.title: Shipping & Taxes
shipping.vatWarning: Note: These settings will be ignored if specific tax rules are defined in the Taxes section.

features.title: Store Features
features.desc: Enable or disable core features and functionalities.
features.reviewsDesc: Allow customers to write reviews on products. When disabled, review buttons are hidden and new reviews are blocked; published reviews stay visible.
features.reviewsVerifiedOnlyDesc: Only customers with a delivered order containing the product can write a review. Requires product reviews to be enabled.
features.couponsDesc: Enable the use of discount codes and coupons.
features.guestCheckoutDesc: Allow customers to checkout without an account.
features.wishlistDesc: Allow customers to save products to their wishlist.

googleReviews.title: Google Reviews
googleReviews.desc: Show real reviews from your Google Business profile on the home page.
googleReviews.enableDesc: When disabled, the home page shows the default testimonials.
googleReviews.reviewsUrlDesc: Paste your business link from Google Maps — the Place ID is detected automatically on save.
googleReviews.placeIdHelp: Auto-detected from the link. Find it manually
googleReviews.apiKeyDesc: Stored encrypted in the database and never shown publicly.
googleReviews.apiKeySaved: A key is already saved (encrypted). Leave blank to keep it, or enter a new key to replace it.

advanced.title: Advanced Options
advanced.inventoryAlertsDesc: Enable low stock alerts when adding items to cart.
advanced.performanceDesc: Display page speed and database performance.
advanced.clearCacheDesc: Clears the entire server cache (products, categories, brands, settings) on all servers and refreshes the store pages. Use it if outdated data appears.
advanced.cacheStatsDesc: Server response cache since the last restart (for the server that answered this request).
advanced.cacheEntriesHint: Oldest entries are evicted at the limit
advanced.storageProviderDesc: Select where new uploaded images and files will be stored.
advanced.storageLocalDesc: Store files on the local server disk (Default).
advanced.storageCloudinaryDesc: Store files on Cloudinary Cloud and Global CDN.

mobileApp.title: Mobile app updates
mobileApp.desc: Control how iOS and Android app users are told about new versions: optional or forced updates.

rules.optional: Raising "Latest version" shows older installs an optional update they can postpone.
rules.required: Raising "Minimum supported version" blocks older versions from using the app until they update.
rules.blocked: "Blocked versions" force specific versions to update (e.g. a build with a serious bug).
rules.storeFirst: Only set a version here once it is actually live in that platform's store, or users will not find the update.

fields.latestVersionDesc: The version currently live in the store.
fields.minSupportedVersionDesc: Any older version is forced to update.
fields.blockedVersionsDesc: Comma-separated. Forced to update even if newer than the minimum.

stats.hint: Counts only devices registered for notifications. Check it before raising the minimum version.

mobileApp.forceWarning: After saving, {count} more {platform} device(s) will be forced to update before using the app.

confirmForce.title: Confirm forced update
confirmForce.message: {count} more {platform} device(s) will be blocked from the app until they update. Make sure the required version is live in the store. Continue?

announce.title: Send update notification
announce.message: Every {platform} user will get a "version {version} is available" notification. Send it?
announce.needsStoreUrl: Add and save the store link first

errors.storeUrl: The link must start with https://
errors.minAboveLatest: The minimum supported version cannot be higher than the latest version
errors.notes: Write the release notes in both languages (3+ characters) or leave both empty

backup.title: Database backups
backup.desc: Automatic, encrypted copies of the database and the uploaded files (images, attachments) saved to Google Drive, independent of the hosting provider.
backup.loadError: Could not load the backup settings.
backup.dstNote: Times follow the store timezone, including daylight-saving changes: a skipped time runs once at the next valid time, a repeated time runs once.

fields.enabledDesc: Run scheduled backups. Turning this off keeps all existing backup files.
fields.backupsPerDayDesc: How many times a day a backup runs (not how many files are kept).
fields.retentionDesc: Older backups are deleted automatically, but the {min} newest backups are always kept.
fields.folderNameDesc: Renaming keeps the same folder and its existing backups.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.fallbackHint: The timezone could not be determined from the store address. Complete the country (and city) in Contact > Business address.

server.disabled: Backups are switched off on the server (BACKUP_ENABLED). Ask your administrator to enable them.
server.overridden: The schedule is overridden on the server (BACKUP_CRON); the times below are not applied.

status.title: Backup status
status.desc: Results of recent backups and the next scheduled run.

runNow.title: Run a backup now?
runNow.message: A full encrypted backup will be created and uploaded to Google Drive in the background. You can follow its progress here.

confirmDisable.title: Turn off automatic backups?
confirmDisable.message: No new backups will be created until you turn this back on. Existing backups in Google Drive are kept.

messages.connected: Connected to Google Drive. The backup folder is accessible.
messages.connectedNoFolder: Connected to Google Drive. The backup folder will be created with the first backup.
messages.connectionFailed: Could not connect to Google Drive. See the error in the status card.

errors.folderName: Use 1-100 characters without quotes or slashes.

page.title: Database Backups
page.subtitle: Schedule, verify, download and test-restore encrypted backups stored in Google Drive.
page.noAccess: You do not have permission to view backups.

files.title: Available backups
files.desc: Every backup in Google Drive, made by the server or uploaded from a device.
files.loadError: Could not load the backups from Google Drive.
files.empty: No backups yet. Run a backup or upload a backup file.
files.downloadHint: Downloads one encrypted file with the database and its uploaded files. Useless without the encryption key.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this uploaded backup?
confirmDelete.message: "{name}" and its file list will be deleted from Google Drive. Backups made by the server are not affected.

upload.wrongType: Choose a .sgbk backup file or a .backup.tar bundle.
upload.tooLarge: The file is larger than the allowed {max}.

testRestore.title: Test restore
testRestore.desc: Restores a backup into the separate database "{db}" so you can check it. The live store is never touched.
testRestore.empty: No test restore yet. Choose "Restore to test database" on a backup above.
testRestore.diffHint: Highlighted rows differ from the live data now: these are the changes made after the backup (they would be lost by switching to it).

switch.title: To switch the store to this backup (only if you are sure)
switch.notTheSlot: Never run the store on "{db}": this panel replaces and deletes it. Restore the backup into a new database instead.
switch.step2: Download this backup and, in server/, restore it into a new database:
switch.step3: On the server set the following, then restart the API:
switch.step4: Restore the uploaded files of the same backup with the "Restore files" button.
switch.warning: Everything changed after the backup (orders, payments, users) will be lost.

confirm.title: Restore into the test database?
confirm.message: The backup from {date} will be restored into a separate test database, replacing the previous test copy. The live store is not affected.

confirmDrop.title: Delete the test database?
confirmDrop.message: The database "{db}" will be deleted. The live store and the backups in Google Drive are not affected.

testRestore.inUseAsLive: "{db}" has been used as the store's live database, so it cannot be replaced or deleted from here. If it is really no longer used, delete it yourself in mongosh.

restoreFiles.title: Restore uploaded files
restoreFiles.subtitle: Images and attachments of the backup from {date}, into the live uploads folder on the server.

preview.title: Preview only
preview.desc: Shows what would be written, what is unchanged and what conflicts. Writes nothing.

restore.title: Restore missing files
restore.desc: Writes files that are missing. Existing files with different content are left untouched and listed as conflicts.

overwrite.title: Restore and replace different files
overwrite.desc: Also replaces existing files whose content differs with the version from the backup.

restoreFiles.overwriteConfirm: I understand that files changed after this backup (e.g. images edited later) will be replaced by their older version.
restoreFiles.note: Nothing is ever deleted: files that are not in the backup stay as they are. Every file is verified before it is written.
restoreFiles.preparing: Reading the backup from Google Drive…

result.conflictsHint: These files exist with different content (probably changed after the backup). They were not replaced.
result.failedHint: Their copy in Google Drive is corrupt or could not be read. Nothing was written for them; the other files were restored.
